title: Deploy and onboard
lead: Deploy for real, import recipes, pair both phones, and run the first weekly plan.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** feature changes. Any problems found become new slices (`--discovered-from`).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The MVP isn't done until the household actually uses it.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. When is the first planning session (pick a day before an order)?
2. A non-technical member's onboarding: the owner pairs their phone and installs the icon. Any preferences on how it's explained to them?

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Deploy per deploy/README.md; bootstrap the admin.
2. Run the Hugo import; tag metadata; clear the review queue.
3. Pair the owner's and a household phone that isn't on the VPNs; install the PWA on both.
4. Run the first weekly plan; generate the list; place the order from it.
5. File any friction as new slices.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Both phones are paired and installed; one real order was placed from larder's list.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
